scope: MotionCheck v2 protocol: temporal alignment, procedure compliance, simulated motion tracking
status: Literature and design review; no reported reproduction or benchmark result

sources.title: Temporal Cycle-Consistency Learning
sources.authors: Debidatta Dwibedi, Yusuf Aytar, Jonathan Tompson, Pierre Sermanet, Andrew Zisserman
sources.verified_claim: Learns frame embeddings through temporal cycle consistency for correspondence and action-phase tasks.
sources.design_use: Alignment is a useful observable, not proof that every required step occurred.
sources.release_note: Official code identified in the v1 review; this review did not install or execute its learned model.

sources.title: Learning by Aligning Videos in Time
sources.authors: Sanjay Haresh, Sateesh Kumar, Huseyin Coskun, Shahram N. Syed, Andrey Konin, M. Zeeshan Zia, Quoc-Huy Tran
sources.verified_claim: Combines Soft-DTW alignment with temporal regularization for self-supervised representation learning.
sources.design_use: Keep temporal discrimination and coverage visible alongside alignment cost.
sources.release_note: Official code identified; no trained dance-compliance model executed. Publication year is 2021.
sources.implementation_relation: Motivation only; a hand-built ordered matcher is not LAV reproduction.

sources.title: FineDiving: A Fine-Grained Dataset for Procedure-Aware Action Quality Assessment
sources.authors: Jinglin Xu, Yongming Rao, Xumin Yu, Guangyi Chen, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
sources.verified_claim: Uses fine-grained diving procedures and query/exemplar step correspondence for action quality assessment.
sources.design_use: Report local stage evidence rather than only a whole-clip scalar.
sources.release_note: Official PyTorch TSA code; dataset access requests a release agreement. README evaluates checkpoints produced by training. Not run here.
sources.limitation: Sport-specific scoring and annotations do not establish general dance instruction compliance.

sources.title: CaptainCook4D: A Dataset for Understanding Errors in Procedural Activities
sources.verified_claim: Provides real procedural recordings with normal/error steps and evaluates error recognition and multistep localization.
sources.design_use: Freeze independent step/error annotations, including order and outcome, before predictions.
sources.release_note: Official project links code, data downloader, task graphs and annotations; not downloaded or evaluated here.
sources.limitation: Cooking is a different domain; object-state errors are not observable from skeletons alone.

sources.title: DeepMimic: Example-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning of Physics-Based Character Skills
sources.authors: Xue Bin Peng, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine, Michiel van de Panne
sources.verified_claim: Learns physics-based control policies with reference imitation and task objectives.
sources.design_use: Evaluate actual state tracking and perturbation recovery, separately from visual similarity.
sources.release_note: Legacy repository is marked deprecated. Author-linked MimicKit provides implementation and pretrained-model testing instructions; not run here.
sources.limitation: Four-hinge fixed-base feedforward/PD tracking is not DeepMimic, RL training, or humanoid balance.

sources.title: AMP: Adversarial Motion Priors for Stylized Physics-Based Character Control
sources.authors: Xue Bin Peng, Ze Ma, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine, Angjoo Kanazawa
sources.verified_claim: Learns an adversarial motion prior from unstructured motion clips to provide style rewards for physical control.
sources.design_use: Motion naturalness and compliance with a specific ordered reference are distinct objectives.
sources.release_note: Author project links legacy implementation and MimicKit; no AMP model trained or evaluated here.
sources.limitation: An explicit PD controller has no learned adversarial prior.

sources.title: MuJoCo Documentation: actuation model and MJCF actuators
sources.verified_claim: Motor, position-servo, control-limit and force-limit semantics differ; simulation must report actual actuator and state quantities.
sources.design_use: Use matched torque motors and caps for feedforward versus encoder-PD ablation, with no state teleportation.
sources.release_note: Stable documentation is mutable; record installed MuJoCo version and model XML/hash in the run manifest.
sources.limitation: Successful simulator control is not evidence of hardware execution or sim-to-real transfer.
